content.value_statement: Writing a tense exploration scene requires pacing, choices, and consistent details. This skill provides a structured Stella Chen chapter with discoveries, danger, and reflective endings.
actual_capabilities: Guides a five-stage cave exploration roleplay with Stella Chen.
Presents player choices at a cave entrance, tunnel junction, and emergency.
Describes bioluminescent crystals, an underground lake, and ancient carvings.
Supports discovery, archaeology, and survival-focused story endings.
Provides pacing and atmosphere guidance for a 30 to 40 minute chapter.
limitations: It is a narrative guide, not real cave-safety instruction.
It covers one character and one science-fiction setting.
It does not generate maps, images, or game software.
It does not replace professional emergency or expedition advice.

use_cases.title: Run a guided adventure scene
use_cases.description: Lead a player through a branching cave expedition with discoveries and a cave-in decision.

use_cases.title: Draft a science-fiction chapter
use_cases.description: Use the staged outline to write an exploration chapter with escalating tension.

use_cases.title: Design narrative game content
use_cases.description: Adapt the choices, discoveries, and endings into a quest outline.

prompt_templates.title: Start the exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Cave Exploration to begin the scene at the cave entrance. Write as Stella Chen and ask me whether to enter.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a tunnel
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the Cave Exploration chapter. Present the three tunnel options and wait for my choice.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on archaeology
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the right-tunnel branch of Cave Exploration. Emphasize the ancient carvings and their scientific interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the full chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt Cave Exploration into a tense 1,200-word interactive scene. Keep Stella cautious, include two player choices, and end with a safe reflection.

output_examples.input: Begin the cave exploration and let me decide whether Stella enters.
output: Stella finds a wide cave entrance behind giant ferns.
She checks the air, marks her route, and asks the player whether to proceed.
Stella enters a narrow passage and finds a ceremonial chamber.
She identifies pictograms that suggest an ancient civilization once lived on the planet.
Stella follows moving air through a narrow route and reaches daylight.
Back at camp, she records the discoveries and plans a safer return.

best_practices: State the desired branch and narrative tone before starting.
Pause at choices so the player can direct the story.
Treat the safety details as fiction, not real expedition guidance.
anti_patterns: Do not use the chapter as instruction for entering real caves.
Do not skip player choices when running an interactive session.
Do not treat speculative discoveries as factual science.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides a branching science-fiction cave exploration roleplay chapter.

faq.question: Who is Stella Chen?
faq.answer: Stella Chen is the explorer and scientist who narrates the scenario.

faq.question: Can I choose the story path?
faq.answer: Yes. The chapter includes choices at the entrance, tunnel split, and crisis.

faq.question: Does it provide real cave safety advice?
faq.answer: No. Its safety details support fiction and should not guide real expeditions.

faq.question: Can I adapt it for a game?
faq.answer: Yes. You can adapt its scenes and branches into a narrative quest outline.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
